record.title: Recover raw SCPI socket endpoint from local stock firmware
record.intent: Search the existing corpus read-only for implementation evidence of the MHO900 socket endpoint.
requirements: Commit tasking before execution. Keep the existing firmware corpus read-only and preserve stock input provenance, hashes, exact locations and analysis evidence in a separate local run.
Find literal port or bind/listen implementation evidence and distinguish meaningful control/data flow from unrelated numeric matches, including ADB uses of the same port.
Keep vendor documentation, implementation-derived evidence and third-party corroboration distinct. Pin relevant scopehal source before relying on its MHO900 transport declaration.
No specimen contact, host address assignment, physical acquisition or instrument state changes. Commit and push redacted conclusions.
acceptance: The endpoint is supported by pinned static evidence or the search has a reproducible bounded negative result.
